name: The Poisoned Court
about: Heirs are dying at feasts across the realm, and the cups all passed through one great lord's hands. Find the poisoner, or be the next one buried.
title: The Poisoned Court

beats.speaker: mourner
beats.text: {first} falls at the feast in {hall}, clutching {first.his} throat. The physicians say a fever. The servants say otherwise.

memory.mourner: I saw {first} die at the table in {hall}. It was no fever.

court.text: {mourner} of {mourner.house}: "{first} was poisoned, Your Grace, I would stake my house on it. Someone at that table wanted {first.him} dead."

options.label: Send the King's own men to question every servant (100 gold)
options.result: The King's men go quietly from kitchen to kitchen. Somebody in {hall} stops sleeping well.

options.label: Double the tasters at every royal table (150 gold)
options.result: Every cup at court passes two tongues before it reaches the King's.

options.label: Accept the physicians' word: a fever
options.hint: nothing now · the poisoner grows bold
options.result: The crown accepts it was a fever. {mourner} does not.

beats.speaker: mourner
text: {second} dies after a wedding cup, and {mourner} rides to Kingsmere without stopping to bury {second.him}.
Another cup, another grave: {second}, of {mourner.house}. The realm's great families begin to eat only what their own cooks make.

court.text: {mourner}: "Two of the realm's heirs are dead, Your Grace, and both cups came from {poisoner}'s cellars. Will you name {poisoner.him}, or wait for a third?"

options.label: Accuse {poisoner} before the whole court
options.hint: {poisoner.houseName} −30 · right or wrong, there's no going back
options.result: The King names {poisoner} before the court. The hall goes silent, and {poisoner} smiles.

options.label: Plant a man in {poisoner}'s household (200 gold)
options.hint: proof, in time · or the spy is found
options.result: A new steward enters {poisoner}'s service at {hall}, recommended by no one.

options.label: Say nothing until there is proof
options.hint: nothing now · the poisoner chooses the next cup
options.result: The King waits for proof. {poisoner} sends him a cask of wine for the new year.

beats.speaker: poisoner
beats.text: With no proof behind it, the King's accusation turns the realm against the crown, not {poisoner}. {poisoner.house} calls it tyranny, and others listen.

beats.speaker: poisoner
beats.text: The King's taster is found dead in the royal kitchens at dawn. The cup was meant for the throne.

court.text: {mourner}, white-faced: "Your Grace, your taster is dead. The next cup is yours. Leave Kingsmere, or end this tonight."

options.label: Leave Kingsmere in secret for a season (300 gold)
options.hint: the court is purged while you're gone · the realm sees you run
options.result: The King rides out of Kingsmere in a merchant's cart. Behind him, the kitchens are emptied and the cellars searched.

options.label: Seize {poisoner} tonight, proof or none
options.result: The King's guard takes {poisoner} from {poisoner.his} bed. The cellars at {hall} are opened.

options.label: Hold the feast as planned: a King is not afraid
options.result: The feast goes ahead. The King lifts his cup.

beats.speaker: poisoner
beats.text: The King lifts the cup. Down the table, {mourner} goes still.

court.text: {mourner}, across the board, barely moving {mourner.his} lips: "Your Grace. Not that cup."

options.label: Set the cup down and call the taster (100 gold)
options.hint: the feast is shamed · {poisoner} is watched from now on
options.result: The King sets the cup down untouched. The taster drinks, and does not rise from the bench. Every eye at the table turns to {poisoner}.

options.label: Drink, and shame the whisperers
options.hint: the court sees a fearless King · if {mourner} is right, it is the last thing it sees
options.result: The King drains the cup to the dregs and turns it over on the board.

beats.text: The King dies at his own table, as the heirs did. {poisoner} weeps loudest at the funeral.

do.fall: The King dies at his own table, poisoned like the heirs before him. {poisoner} weeps loudest at the funeral, and the crown passes to whoever {poisoner.he} chooses.

beats.speaker: mourner
beats.text: The poison is found in {poisoner}'s cellars at {hall}, in the steward's own hand. {poisoner} is taken in chains, and the realm's cups are safe again.

die.how: the headsman, for the poisoned court

memory.mourner: The King found who poisoned the heirs, and the dead are answered.

beats.text: {poisoner} dies, and the poisonings stop. Nobody at court says why aloud.
